note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs/B-L records with HS codes and B-L numbers (latest 2026-02-10; destinations Liberia, UAE, Nigeria; ports Nhava Sheva and Sahar Air Cargo). Declared HS 842511 is correct as the primary code; actual shipment codes observed are 84251110, 84261100 and 84311010, so the code set should be widened rather than the company rejected.
